description: This is a shell script used for testing git application of patches, including setup for test files, running tests, and checking outputs for filename consistency in patches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up and runs a successful test condition, capturing success criteria and expected behaviors.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Outputs the contents of specified files; used here to create patch files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to verify error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a specified output or file to verify expected error messages.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script or test case sequence.
